subject: Draft MAP & pricing ask — Cerulean Health
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Walsh <ben.walsh@ceruleanhealth.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & pricing ask — Cerulean Health

Hi Ben and Claire,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for walking through your latency and compliance constraints. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short pricing options spreadsheet for the consumption model we discussed. Key items below (high-level):

- Target close date: 2026-11-15 (aligns with your procurement window).
- Milestones and owners:
  • MAP 1 (Pilot + Integration): Redwood to provide sandbox + integrations guide — owner: Kimberly (Redwood) — target complete: 2026-10-30.
  • MAP 2 (SOC2 evidence & security review): Cerulean to complete questionnaire & provide environment access — owner: Claire (Cerulean) — target complete: 2026-11-05.
  • MAP 3 (Performance validation): Joint load test (lower-volume then scale) — owners: Redwood infra & Cerulean engineering — target: 2026-11-09.
  • Contract/PO & Billing: Cerulean procurement to issue PO; Redwood to accept commit level — target: 2026-11-15.

Dependencies and risks:
- SOC2 evidence and the network allowlist are blockers for Dedicated/private deployment.
- If procurement requires a signature from a legal entity that changes billing cadence, this may push the target close by 1–2 weeks.

Pricing ask (summary in attached spreadsheet):
- Option A: 12-month committed plan — $125k ARR commit, unit pricing tier, and a one-time onboarding credit.
- Option B: Monthly consumption — higher per-token rate, no credit or commit.

Action items for Cerulean:
1) Confirm target close date and preferred pricing option by EOD Friday 2026-10-22.
2) Share the SOC2 questionnaire answers and an initial PO template if available.
3) Confirm who from procurement will own the PO and the expected signatory.

I’ve attached: Cerulean_MAP_draft_v0.3.pdf and pricing_options_Cerulean.xlsx.

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call to walk through the MAP.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Cerulean_MAP_draft_v0.3.pdf (MAP), pricing_options_Cerulean.xlsx (pricing options)
From: Ben Walsh <ben.walsh@ceruleanhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & pricing ask — Cerulean Health

Thanks Kim — appreciated the recap and the quick MAP. A few clarifying points from procurement/finance on our side:

1) Pricing flexibility: Procurement is pushing for some form of an upfront credit or discount given our limited budget for Q4 pilots. Would Redwood consider a 25–30% onboarding credit (or equivalent one-time dollar credit) against the first quarter?s usage?
2) Commit level: We can move to a 12-month commit but we would be comfortable at ~ $90k ARR if that makes a difference for your discounting.
3) SOC2: We can share the SOC2 questionnaire answers by 2026-10-27, but we need a short list of the exact artifacts Redwood can commit to provide (e.g., key policies, evidence excerpts).

We’re keen to keep to the 11/15 target but procurement needs a clear economic justification for the budget owner. Can you escalate the credit request? Also, do you have any flexibility around a shorter minimum commitment term?

—Ben
Ben Walsh
Director of Product — Cerulean Health
ben.walsh@ceruleanhealth.com
+1 617-555-0912

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Walsh <ben.walsh@ceruleanhealth.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP & pricing ask — Cerulean Health (pricing escalation)

Marissa / Aditya — looping you in. Cerulean is asking for a significant onboarding credit (25–30%) and signaling willingness to sign a 12-month commit but at a lower ARR (~$90k). Procurement needs economics for budget owner by COB next week.

Quick deal context (short):
- Current ask: 25–30% one-time credit OR equivalent dollar credit against Q1 usage.
- Proposed Redwood anchoring: 12-month commit at $125k ARR for 18–20% one-time credit OR $10k one-time onboarding credit if commit at $125k.
- Risk: If we push commit to $90k to support discount, unit price tiers will be less favorable and long-term ARR reduces.

Attached is a simple model (pricing_options_Cerulean.xlsx). Can we get exec guidance on whether we can (A) offer a one-time onboarding credit at 18% conditional on $125k 12-month commit, (B) accept a $90k commit and reduce credit to 10%, or (C) provide a limited $15k credit while keeping a month-to-month consumption option? Procurement wants clear yes/no to pass to budget owner.

Time pressure: They’ve asked for confirmation by EOD Friday 2026-10-22. If we don’t expedite, they’ll move to a competitor’s short-listing process.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_options_Cerulean.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Walsh <ben.walsh@ceruleanhealth.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MAP & pricing ask — Cerulean Health (pricing escalation)

Kim — thanks for the summary and for surfacing the procurement ask. I’m supportive of a constrained concession to keep this committed deal on track with clear guardrails.

Approved concession (exec):
- One-time onboarding credit: 18% of first-year committed spend if Cerulean signs a 12-month committed plan at minimum $125k ARR. The credit will be applied as a dollar credit to the first invoice(s).
- Alternative: If Cerulean insists on a $90k ARR commit, we can offer a $10k one-time onboarding credit (final) but must escalate to Sales Ops for margin review — this requires written confirmation and will delay by 24–48 hours.
- No additional multi-quarter credits will be approved without SVP signoff.

Conditions & next steps:
1) Legal to prepare the 12-month SOW with the agreed commit and the credit clause. Katie (Legal) to own contract redlines — Kimberly, please open the DocuSign envelope and route to Cerulean procurement.
2) Security: Redwood will provide the SOC2_summary.pdf excerpts and an official SOC2 artifact checklist by 2026-10-27. Claire, we will need the questionnaire answers by that date to finish the security sign-off.
3) Pricing Ops: Aditya — please confirm margins on the $125k commit + 18% credit and confirm final approval for the $10k alt-credit path.

Kimberly — you have exec-level approval to present the $125k / 18% credit package as the primary option. If Cerulean pushes back to $90k, escalate immediately to me and cc Sales Ops.

Marissa Cole
VP, GTM — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 650-555-0784
